Mr. Kay asked you some questions -- and perhaps if you could put it on the overhead projector and if that could be activated, please -- you were asked some questions about where Mr. Tadic was, where Mr. Borovnica was and where the men were that were standing up against the wall with their hands against the wall of the kiosk. Would you please take the pen that is there and in as big a size as you possibly can, would you please draw the kiosk itself and indicate where it was that these men were actually standing?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Do you want me to draw it on this sheet of paper or another one?

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: No, I want you to ----

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Because this was in reverse.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: Yes. If you draw it on this sheet of paper, if you can, draw where the cabin was and the wall against which the men were standing, if you can do that?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: (The witness marked on the plan). This will look very small, so that I will only mark it with dots and I will draw the kiosk.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: OK. Could you mark with dots the places where the five men were standing? I realise they have to be rather small dots.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I can. (The witness marked on the plan).

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: Thank you. That is fine. You are marking where other men were standing there as well now. Those are the couple of marks that you put there, that are the men that were standing there at the time?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: This dot here, the first one, that is roughly where Dusko Tadic stood and Gajic here and Borovnica was standing here behind those men.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: When we showed you the video earlier today we saw in the video a wooden style cabin or a wooden style building on the corner. Was that building there at the time when you saw Dusko Tadic back in May 1992, or do you assume that it has been subsequently put in that place?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: That shed did not exist there before and how it got there I do not know, but all I know I was born there. I always passed that way. I was doing my shopping there and whatever I needed and did not need. That shed which is on the video, because the video is of very poor quality, but when I looked at how it was positioned and it was not positioned at all in the direction where the kiosks were, is far to the right toward Kalate and not down Kozarac, down the high street where the kiosks were.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: Thank you. I have no further questions.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Mr. Kay?

utterances.speaker: MR. KAY
utterances.text: Nothing arising, thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VOHRAH
utterances.text: Mr. Mujcic, for completeness of the record, in what year were you born?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I was born on 20th April 1954.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: You mentioned that the biscuits were distributed on the 16th. How did you know that that was 16th, the day when the biscuits were distributed?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Because when this Jasko distributed those biscuits he mentioned the birthday of his child. He uttered the word, "16th, today is the 16th", and, according to him, it was dedicated to his child and he said it was on behalf of his child who had his birthday that day, and that he was distributing, offering those biscuits on his child's birthday, and he told us that the 16th was, that that date was the 16th.

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: Yes. My question is how did he know that that particular day was the 16th?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: I do not know that, how did he know that that day was the 16th.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE VOHRAH
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Mr. Niemann, do you have additional questions?

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: No thank you, your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Mr. Kay?

utterances.speaker: MR. KAY
utterances.text: No thank you, your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: Is there any objection to Mr. Mujcic being permanently excused?

utterances.speaker: MR. KAY
utterances.text: No, your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: You are permanently excused, Mr. Mujcic. Thank you for coming. You may leave now. Is there something else you wish to bring to our attention?

utterances.speaker: MR. NIEMANN
utterances.text: No, your Honour.

utterances.speaker: THE PRESIDING JUDGE
utterances.text: We will adjourn until 10 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: (The court adjourned for a short time)
(The hearing adjourned until the following day)
